title: Effect of Ti/Ta ratio on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Hf20Mo15Nb25Ta20-xTi20+x refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying of elemental powders (>99.5% purity, ~45 μm) in stainless steel milling jars with 304 stainless steel balls at 400 rpm for 50 hours (ball-to-powder ratio 10:1, argon atmosphere), followed by spark plasma sintering at 1450°C for 15 minutes under 50 MPa pressure.
